Additionally, we showed that during unstable utility condi- tions, the Verrus secondary control system (PFMS) can switch nearly instantaneously to the BESS units to provide backup power to the data center. The PFMS can also reconnect the data center to the grid once stable utility conditions return. The Vulcan test platform results confirm that the IT load is not impacted and continues to operate within the customer uptime commitments. Beyond the scenarios pre- sented in this report, the Vulcan platform can be used for future case studies on grid disturbances and dynamic IT load profiles, and it is particularly well suited to study transient effects during interactions between the data center and the grid. 22 This report is available at no cost from the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) at www.nrel.gov/publications 7 References [1] T.
